subject.why: The space capsule includes the orange float ring, round window, three striped parachutes, and moon emblem.

category.why: Follows Category 4 with a solid water base across the bottom and a simple sky background.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The subject is centrally composed with safe margins on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with clean separation between the subject and background.

detail.why: Features clean, broad shapes with no distracting micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Matches the smooth, chunky 3D toy aesthetic and satin finish of the reference images.
